messages.subject: Passing parameters to scale_y_continuous
parts:
Good Evening,

I am trying to pass parameters to scale_y_continuous as in:

minY<- 1
maxY<-10

scale_y_continuous(limits=c(minY,maxY)) or to ylim(minY,maxY)

but I get very strange behavior or just errors compared to when passing:

scale_y_continuous(limits=c(1,10)) or to ylim(1,10)

Is there a way ( I am sure there is) to equate the behavior of ggplot2 when passing parameters vs. actual values?

Thank you for your help.

David

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: Passing parameters to scale_y_continuous
parts:
What exactly is strange behavior or errors? Can you provide a MRE? 

This works as expected for me:

lower_lim = 0
upper_lim = 10
ggplot(data.frame(a=1:3, b=4:6), aes(a,b)) + geom_point()
ggplot(data.frame(a=1:3, b=4:6), aes(a,b)) + geom_point() + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 10))
ggplot(data.frame(a=1:3, b=4:6), aes(a,b)) + geom_point() + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(lower_lim, upper_lim))

Best wishes,
Doug
